title: Bless us, O Lord, and these thy gifts.
html_source:
The beginning of the traditional Catholic form of grace, a prayer said before meals: “Bless us, O Lord, and these Thy gifts, which we are about to receive from Thy bounty, through Christ our Lord.
Amen.” Since the whole prayer is only about a sentence long, Mulligan cutting it off in the middle indicates he’s not taking it very seriously.
